contexts.text: Therefore He is called... the Saviour, which is His name Jesus.

When the two names of our Lord, Jesus Christ, are mentioned, few have any other idea than that they are proper names, and almost like the names of any other man, but more holy. The learned do indeed know that Jesus means Saviour, and Christ, the Anointed, and they thence apprehend some interior idea. But still it is not these things which the Angels in Heaven perceive from these names. They are things still more Divine; namely, by Jesus, when it is named by a man who is reading the Word, they perceive the Divine good; and by Christ, the Divine truth; and by both, the Divine marriage of good and truth, and of truth and good; thus everything Divine in the heavenly marriage, which is Heaven.
The Priestly represented the Divine marriage of truth in good: this is signified by Jesus.
The name Jesus involves the Divine good. AC 8625.
The Lord's two names, Jesus and Christ = the Divine marriage (of good and truth) which is in the Lord.
The Lord is called... Jesus, or Saviour, when good is treated of.
From the Divine Celestial, the Lord in the world was called Jesus...

In the Spiritual World, where everyone is held in speaking as he is thinking, no one can even name Jesus, except him who has lived in the world as a Christian; and this... lest His name should be profaned.
The revelation of Jesus Christ () = predictions by the Lord concerning Himself and His Church... AE 5.
The testimony of Jesus Christ () = those who acknowledge the Human of the Lord to be Divine. AR 35.
By Jesus Christ, and by the Lamb, in the Apocalypse, is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human.
From Jesus Christ () = the Divine Human.
The patient expectation of Jesus Christ () = the Advent of the Lord.

They who had confirmed faith separated from charity were told to say Jesus; but they could not, but they could all say Christ... The reason was that they did not pray to the Saviour Himself; for Jesus means Saviour. TCR 111.
The faith of Jesus () = faith in the Lord... ( = the implantation of truth by the Lord. AE 895.)

I saw the souls of those who were smitten with the axe for the testimony of Jesus () = those who were rejected... because they worshipped the Lord... the testimony of Jesus = the acknowledgement of the Divine of the Lord in His Human.

I Jesus have sent mine Angel () = a testification by the Lord... The reason the Lord here names Himself Jesus, is that all in the Christian world may know that the Lord Himself, who was in the world, manifested the things which are described in this Book, as also the things which have now been opened.

Even come, Lord Jesus () = that in His Divine Human which He took to Himself in the world, and glorified, He comes as the Bridegroom and Husband, and that the Church desires Him as the bride and wife.

That the Lord will come in the Divine Human which He took to Himself in the world, and glorified, is evident from the fact that He names Himself Jesus... and that the Church here says, Come, Lord Jesus.
(The Divine Trinity in the Lord Jesus Christ. Explained.) AR 962:12.
He is our Lord Jesus Christ both as to the Divine a quo, and as to the Divine Human...
A Trinity of Person, which is given solely in the Lord Jesus Christ.

This Only God is the Lord Jesus Christ, who is Jehovah the Lord; the Creator from eternity, the Saviour in time, and the Reformer to eternity; thus who is at once the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
That this faith is in the Lord God the Saviour Jesus Christ... There is One God, in whom is the Divine Trinity, and He is the Lord Jesus Christ. BE 117:3. TCR 3. SciaDoc 10.
It is a universal of faith that God is one in Essence and in Person, in whom is the Trinity, and that the Lord God the Saviour Jesus Christ is He. DFaith 34. AR 67.
The Lord is called Jesus from the priestly office; and Christ from the regal office.

That the name Jesus is in like manner holy, is known from the apostle's saying, that at that name the knees are bent and are to be bent, in Heaven and on earth; and besides that it can be named by no devil in Hell.

By the name of Jesus Christ is meant everything of redemption, and everything of His doctrine, and thus everything of salvation; by Jesus, everything of salvation through redemption; and by Christ, everything of salvation through His doctrine.
(Thus) everyone who wants to be truly a Christian, and to be saved by Christ, ought to believe that Jesus is the Son of the Living God.
For no satan can endure to... hear Jesus named.

They who have confirmed themselves in falsities of religion, and also those who have led an evil life... associate themselves with their like, who are in Hell, where more and more they confirm themselves against the worship of the Lord... insomuch that they cannot endure to hear the name of Jesus.
God Himself, who in His Human is called Jesus Christ...
On those there who have Jesus with them, as they believe; and those who have Christ.

It was asked whether (the inhabitants of Jupiter) know that their Only Lord is a Man. The Spirit said that they know it... and that their Only Lord is Jesus Christ. They do not indeed call Him by this name; but that He is the Supreme, who is called Jesus Christ, is now unanimously confessed by all... As to the name King, they suppose that it is beneath His dignity, because the name of King savours of what is worldly; and that Jesus means Saviour they acknowledge, because it is the same as the Preserver of all. (Compare AC 8543.)

a. I spoke with (the Most Ancients) concerning other ideas by which the Lord is expressed, as Jesus, and Christ. This they could not perceive, because the ideas are overwhelmed with natural things, because they are names.

To acknowledge Jesus Christ at heart is to acknowledge the Divine in His Human; for he who acknowledges the Lord, and does not at the same time acknowledge the Divine in His Human, does not acknowledge the Lord; for His Divine is in His Human, and not outside of it...

From Jesus Christ = from the Lord as to the Divine Human; as is evident from the fact that this was the name of the Lord in the world, thus the name of His Human; but as to the Divine His name was Jehovah, and God. It is said the Divine Human, because the Lord made His Human Divine when He was in the world...
That by the two names Jesus, and Christ are signified both His Priestly and His Royal; namely, by Jesus the Divine good, and by Christ the Divine truth. References.

The expectation of Jesus Christ = where there is the Knowledge of the Divine of the Lord in His Human. (For) the expectation of Jesus Christ = when that time comes when the Church will Know the Lord; and the Church Knows the Lord when it acknowledges the Divine in His Human.
For the testimony of Jesus Christ = in order that the Lord's Divine Human may be acknowledged. The names Jesus Christ = the Lord as to the Divine Human.
By Jesus is meant the Lord as to the Divine good; and by Christ, the Lord as to the Divine truth. References.
Hence it is that the Lord has been called Jesus; for Jesus = salvation.
And have the testimony of Jesus Christ () = and acknowledge the Divine in the Lord's Human.

With the blood of the witnesses of Jesus () = violence inflicted on those truths of the Word which teach that the Lord alone is to be adored... The witnesses of Jesus = those who at heart acknowledge the Lord, and worship and adore Him alone.
The Divine truth is Christ; the Divine good proceeding is Jesus...
On God the Saviour Jesus Christ.
Redeemer. 9. 7. Thus and no otherwise can Christ Jesus be in Angels and men, and Angels and men in Him.
Redeemer. 10. 1. In Jesus Christ the Divine from eternity and the Human in time are united as are the soul and body in man.
Trinity. 4. The Trinity... was made in God incarnate, who is the Lord our Saviour Jesus Christ. CanonsNC 5. CanonsNC 7.
That in Christ Jesus Man is God, and God Man... Inv 47. Inv 54.
